about.manifesto.title: Engineering expertise. Coordinated BIM delivery.
about.manifesto.lead: Based in Padua, Italy, pyBIM provides specialist BIM services for architecture studios, engineering consultancies and construction companies. We combine architectural, structural and MEP modeling, multidisciplinary BIM coordination, technical model verification and digital documentation with computational design and custom Revit automation.
about.manifesto.rd_note: Our core business is BIM engineering. Alongside client projects, we develop our own digital tools, adapting our workflows to agreed information requirements and applicable technical standards.
about.manifesto.aria_label: pyBIM engineering capabilities and technology roadmap: current BIM engineering services and future software and AI research
about.manifesto.phase1_desc: Specialist modeling, multidisciplinary coordination, model QA/QC and digital deliverables.
about.manifesto.phase2_desc: Connected Revit automation and cloud workflow management. Target commercial release: Q4 2027, subject to final integration, reliability and security validation.
about.manifesto.phase3_desc: Future private AI research based on shared Phase II foundations. Dedicated development begins after Phase II completion and final validation. No commercial availability or announced release date.
about.philosophy.title: Engineering expertise at the center of BIM delivery.
about.philosophy.subtitle: Effective BIM delivery combines technical expertise, established project processes and suitable digital tools. Our approach adapts these elements to the requirements of each project.
about.philosophy.col1_primary: Established BIM workflows rely on specialist modeling, technical coordination, information exchange and project-specific reviews.
about.philosophy.col1_supporting: As project complexity increases, repetitive tasks and information exchanges may require additional coordination and structured verification.
about.philosophy.col2_primary: We combine specialist BIM modeling, multidisciplinary coordination and technical model verification with computational design and project-specific automation.
about.philosophy.col2_supporting: Our work is guided by agreed project requirements, information needs and technical responsibilities. Alongside client projects, we develop digital tools to support engineering workflows.
about.philosophy.col2_status_rd: Software development and future AI research
about.philosophy.col2_status_note: BIM engineering is our core commercial activity. Future software and AI products are not generally available and remain subject to development and technical validation.
about.philosophy.col3_primary: Established BIM platforms provide essential tools for modeling, information management, coordination and technical documentation.
about.philosophy.col3_supporting: Project-specific requirements may call for additional configuration, tailored automation or specialist engineering support.
about.journey.title: BIM engineering today. Digital tools for the future.
about.journey.subtitle: Our development roadmap builds on specialist BIM engineering, multidisciplinary coordination and project-specific automation. Current engineering services remain our core business while we develop complementary software and explore future AI technologies.
about.journey.p1_primary: We provide architectural, structural and MEP modeling, multidisciplinary BIM coordination, model QA/QC, Scan-to-BIM, CAD-to-BIM and custom Revit automation within agreed project environments.
about.journey.p1_supporting: Our work is based on agreed technical responsibilities, information requirements and delivery milestones. We support existing project teams without replacing their project management or formal approval responsibilities.
about.journey.p1_focus: Specialist modeling · BIM coordination · Technical verification
about.journey.p2_primary: Our proprietary software platform is being developed for connected Revit automation and cloud-based BIM workflow management. Development focuses on reusable tools and project-specific engineering workflows.
about.journey.p2_supporting: The platform is not yet generally available. The target commercial release is Q4 2027, subject to final integration, reliability and security validation.
about.journey.p2_focus: Revit automation · Cloud workflows · Private evaluation
about.journey.p3_primary: Our future AI research explores locally operated AI for engineering workflows within client-controlled environments. The 30% indicator represents technological foundations shared with Phase II, not completion of a dedicated AI product.
about.journey.p3_supporting: Dedicated development will begin only after Phase II completion and final validation. No commercial availability or release date has been announced.
about.journey.p3_focus: Private AI research · Local inference · Engineering oversight
about.journey.beyond_desc: Future development priorities will be shaped by engineering requirements, technical feasibility and validation. Our commitment to current BIM project services remains unchanged.
about.cta.section_subtitle: Explore opportunities to improve BIM workflows, develop your career, and collaborate on engineering solutions.
about.cta.c1_subtitle: Review the cost of recurring BIM tasks and explore opportunities for targeted automation with an editable ROI workbook.
about.cta.c1_item1_desc: Identify recurring BIM activities and estimate the engineering time they require.
about.cta.c1_item2_desc: Use your BIM modeller count and hourly rate to establish a cost baseline.
about.cta.c1_item3_desc: Adjust workbook assumptions to explore potential efficiency improvements.
about.cta.c1_sub: Complete a short form to download the Excel workbook. Estimates depend on your inputs and are not guaranteed savings.
about.cta.c2_subtitle: Explore career opportunities and technical collaboration in BIM engineering, Python/C# automation, and software development.
about.cta.c2_item1_desc: Explore available roles and see where your skills could contribute.
about.cta.c2_item2_desc: Introduce your technical background even when no suitable position is advertised.
about.cta.c2_item3_desc: Connect with us around BIM automation, engineering workflows, and software solutions.
about.cta.c2_sub: Available roles may change. Spontaneous applications and technical portfolios are also welcome.
about.team.sec1.title: The People Behind pyBIM
about.team.sec1.desc: pyBIM brings together BIM engineering and software development. Our founders connect project requirements with practical digital tools and maintain clear technical responsibility across the delivery process.
about.team.sec1.footer: A focused founding team, with a delivery model designed to expand responsibly as project needs change.
about.team.scalable.title: A Focused Core. Flexible Delivery Capacity.
about.team.scalable.desc: Our founders lead technical planning, coordination and quality review. When a project requires additional capacity, pyBIM can organize project-based collaboration with suitable BIM or software specialists, subject to scope and availability. Responsibility for coordination and delivery remains clearly defined within the core team.
about.team.scalable.step1_desc: Defined technical responsibilities and project priorities.
about.team.scalable.step2_desc: Additional expertise planned around scope and availability.
about.team.scalable.step3_desc: Agreed reviews, communication and deliverable checks.
about.team.ecosystem.title: BIM Automation & AI Architecture
about.team.ecosystem.subtitle: How pyBIM connects engineering workflows, structured BIM information, software automation and locally operated AI. Selected systems are already in internal use, while additional capabilities remain under active development.
about.team.ecosystem.manifest_desc: We translate recurring BIM tasks and engineering requirements into structured, testable processes that can guide automation and technical review.
about.team.ecosystem.hub_desc: We organize project requirements, model information and exchange data into formats that support traceability, coordination and software-based processing.
about.team.ecosystem.api_desc: We develop Python and C#/.NET tools to support BIM tasks and explore integrations with Revit and Navisworks APIs according to project requirements and technical constraints.
about.team.ecosystem.v1_desc: Selected automation and AI workloads run in local environments. Processing locations and security controls are evaluated according to the requirements of each project.
about.team.ecosystem.v2_desc: Our Ollama-based local LLM and RAG workflows already support selected internal engineering tasks. Further capabilities are being developed and validated before wider client-facing release.
about.team.ecosystem.v3_desc: Structured checks can help review BIM data, identify issues and support consistency with project requirements. Final compliance and deliverable decisions remain subject to engineering review.
about.tech.section_title: Specialist BIM services. Digital tools. Technical standards.
about.tech.section_subtitle: Explore our BIM engineering services, the technologies supporting our engineering work and software development, and the technical standards and research topics relevant to our activities.
about.tech.pillar1_sub: Specialist BIM modeling, multidisciplinary coordination, technical model verification, Scan-to-BIM, CAD-to-BIM and CDE support.
about.tech.f1_1_desc: Specialist technical consulting supporting project teams and organizations on BIM processes, information requirements and delivery workflows within agreed project responsibilities.
about.tech.f1_2_desc: Multidisciplinary BIM modeling, CAD-to-BIM conversion, parametric families, quantity extraction and model maintenance within agreed scope.
about.tech.f1_3_desc: Discipline and multidisciplinary BIM coordination, clash detection, model checking, technical requirements verification and issue tracking.
about.tech.f1_4_desc: 2D technical drafting, CAD format conversion, drawing preparation, revisions and detailing sheets produced within agreed technical scope (without statutory design sign-off or fabrication approval).
about.tech.f1_5_desc: Specialist technical support within customer-provided Common Data Environments (CDE), covering data organization, permission schemes, review workflows and openBIM exchange without assuming independent BIM Manager authority.
about.tech.f1_5_items: ACC / BIM Collaborate Pro / Autodesk Docs
about.tech.pillar2_sub: Programming languages, BIM APIs, computational design tools and software technologies supporting engineering workflows and platform development.
about.tech.f2_1_desc: Core programming and database query languages used for engineering automation, data processing and software development.
about.tech.f2_2_desc: Desktop and cloud BIM APIs paired with visual scripting and computational design environments.
about.tech.f2_3_desc: Backend frameworks and integration patterns supporting internal engineering tools and ongoing platform development.
about.tech.f2_4_desc: Web application frameworks and browser-based 3D BIM model visualization libraries used in software development.
about.tech.f2_5_desc: Established relational database technology alongside experimental vector storage and RAG workflows under internal R&D.
about.tech.f2_6_desc: Reporting tools, data-exchange platforms and software-level openBIM interoperability formats.
about.tech.pillar3_sub: Information-management standards, regulatory frameworks, openBIM specifications and exploratory research into locally operated AI.
about.tech.f3_1_desc: International and national information-management frameworks used as project reference standards (without implying company certification).
about.tech.f3_2_desc: Historical Italian public-procurement decrees and regulatory provisions applicable exclusively to the Italian regulatory context.
about.tech.f3_3_desc: Vendor-neutral information exchange specifications and semantic data dictionaries for multidisciplinary BIM workflows.
about.tech.f3_4_desc: Information need levels, delivery planning methods and structured handover specifications aligned with project requirements.
about.tech.f3_5_desc: Reference classification systems and structured parameter conventions selected according to project specifications.
about.tech.f3_6_desc: Future exploratory Phase III research into locally operated AI assistance under engineering oversight (not a commercially available AI product).
about.tech.detail_notice_p1: Phase I BIM engineering services are available today within agreed project requirements and technical responsibilities. Scan-to-BIM uses supplied survey data (on-site laser scanning and geodetic surveying are excluded).
about.tech.detail_notice_p2: Technologies support current project automation and Phase II (pyBIM Cloud Connect, 70% progress, target release Q4 2027, subject to final integration, reliability and security validation; not generally available).
about.tech.detail_notice_p3: Technical standards serve as project frameworks rather than company certifications. Phase III (Sovereign Enterprise Edge AI, 30% shared Phase II foundations) is future R&D starting after Phase II validation (no commercial availability or release date).
about.impact.v2.title: Better Engineering Workflows. Greater Control.
about.impact.v2.subtitle: pyBIM combines engineering expertise, structured information management, and the selective use of technology to support more consistent and efficient BIM delivery.
about.impact.v2.outcome1.title: Less Repetitive Work
about.impact.v2.outcome1.desc: Structured processes and selective automation can reduce repetitive tasks, allowing engineers to focus on coordination, technical review, and project decisions.
about.impact.v2.outcome2.title: More Reliable Model Information
about.impact.v2.outcome2.desc: Defined information requirements and review procedures support clearer model data, identifiable discrepancies, and better-controlled BIM deliverables.
about.impact.v2.outcome3.title: Connected Multidisciplinary Delivery
about.impact.v2.outcome3.desc: Coordination across disciplines, software environments, and OpenBIM exchanges supports more organized collaboration and information handover.
about.impact.v2.automation.label: APPLIED AUTOMATION / INTERNAL DEVELOPMENT
about.impact.v2.automation.text: Connected BIM automation is being developed and tested internally to support engineering workflows. It is not yet offered as a standalone public product.
about.impact.v2.standards.label: INFORMATION MANAGEMENT & STANDARDS
about.impact.v2.standards.text: Our engineering workflows draw on relevant ISO 19650 information-management principles and UNI 11337 requirements where applicable, together with the agreed project scope and client requirements.
